title: A vagal gut-brain axis for feeding-induced gastric secretion in mice
title_zh: 小鼠进食诱导胃分泌的迷走神经肠脑轴
abstract: Feeding begins with food-seeking and ends with nutrient absorption and waste elimination. Although meal-related sensory cues shape feeding behavior, how they engage neural circuits to control digestion remains unclear. We dissected vagal gut-brain-gut pathways mediating meal-induced gastric secretion. Stomach-innervating vagal afferents were necessary and sufficient for secretion. Among them, Glp1r+ and Sst+ neurons drove acid, pepsin, and gastrin secretion, whereas Oxtr+ and Vip+ neurons had little effect. Piezo2 was expressed in Glp1r+ mechanosensory afferents, and conditional deletion of Piezo2 attenuated distension-evoked secretion. On the efferent limb, genetically defined vagal motor-neuron subsets showed distinct secretory effects: Cck+ neurons broadly increased acid, pepsin, and gastrin, whereas Grp+ neurons preferentially affected acid secretion. Finally, enteric circuit dissection revealed modular output control, with Calb2+ neurons driving secretion with minimal motility effects. Together, these results define a cell-type-resolved vagal-enteric architecture for gastric control.
abstract_zh: 进食始于寻找食物，终于营养吸收与废物排除。虽然餐食相关的感官线索塑造进食行为，但它们如何调控神经回路以控制消化仍不清楚。我们剖析了介导餐食诱导胃分泌的迷走神经肠脑肠通路。胃部支配的迷走传入神经既是必要的，也是足够的。其中特别是Glp1r+和Sst+神经元驱动酸、胃蛋白酶和胃泌素的分泌，而Oxtr+和Vip+神经元影响甚微。Piezo2在Glp1r+机械感受传入神经中表达，条件性敲除Piezo2可减弱膨胀诱导的分泌。至于传出支路，基因定义的迷走运动神经子集表现出不同的分泌效应：Cck+神经元广泛增加酸、胃蛋白酶和胃泌素，而Grp+神经元则更偏向影响酸分泌。最后，肠道回路剖析揭示了模块化输出控制，Calb2+神经元驱动分泌且对运动影响最小。综上，这些结果定义了一个细胞类型分辨的迷走-肠道架构，用于胃部控制。
